workflow: TripLOG + image-first-frontend-design + image-creator + Product Design ideate
sourcePolicy: Attached screenshots were read as task context, not passed as image inputs, following the project's T2I default. Each variant was generated independently, never from another generated image.

assets.prompt:
Create a Korean TripLOG UI mockup for the “오늘의 여행” flow, in one compact daily-overview direction. Show two aligned 390 × 844 app-only views on an 820 × 884 board: the main screen and its opened “이날 지출” detail sheet. Use white surfaces, navy #0b1020, yellow #fff05a for the primary action, pastel blue #bce6fb and pink #f7afc7, thin outlines and restrained small offset shadows, matching the existing project. Use Pretendard-like Korean typography: body 13–14px regular/medium, place name 18px semibold, money 22px semibold, secondary labels 12px. Avoid oversized heavy text. Use reusable colorful category emoji and small consistent line icons, without extra icon containers.

Current date anchor: 2026-11-01, Sunday. The main screen shows TripLOG, “오늘의 여행”, “Day 1 · 11.1 (일) · 순천”, and a compact next-place surface: “09:30”, “순천만 국가정원”, “전남 순천시 · 순천만 국가정원”, copy and pencil icons. Group “방문 완료”, yellow “길찾기”, and small “건너뛰기” with 40–44px touch areas. Make “여기부터 시작” a quiet inline play-icon action beside “이후 일정”. Show 12:00 점심 식사 and 15:00 순천만습지, then a compact wallet row “이날 지출 44,000원 · 2건”, and the existing five-item navigation.

The detail sheet prioritizes 44,000원 and 2건, with a clear two-part horizontal category bar and icon rows: 🍽️ 식비 32,000원, 🚆 교통 12,000원. Put “전체 누적 286,800원 · 9건” and its included “사전구매 195,600원” in a smaller separate summary. Do not add overlapping totals together. Replace long explanatory text with concise labels and a small refund-minus cue. Finish with “지출 내역 보기”. No device frame or OS chrome. No image inputs.
